_comment: Object budget per category (grab_core::Budget, #85). cap: most objects alive; persistence_cap: loose ones kept on a planet the players left (frozen until they come back); timeout_s: a loose one resting on a planet nobody touched this long goes; far_m: a loose one still moving (drifting in space) this far from every player and ship goes. Held, locked and cabin objects never go. TODO(initiator): all values are starting points.
